description: Forward Inbox Message - Forward an email to another recipient. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

attachments.description: NOT supported on this connector — providing file paths returns an error. Attach files via the SalesBlink web app instead.

content.description: Optional additional message content (defaults to the original email body)

email.description: Recipient email address (defaults to the original contact if omitted)

scheduled_time.description: Unix timestamp in ms to schedule the forward. If omitted or in the past, the forward is sent after a short delay.

selectedTimezone.description: IANA timezone to use when tzMode='custom'

tzMode.description: Timezone mode: 'sequence' uses the sequence timezone, 'custom' uses selectedTimezone

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: forward_inbox_message

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Forward Inbox Message
